name: sf-compound-engineering
description: Salesforce compound engineering: ten skills (plan, work, generate, review, debug, deploy, ship, compound, lfg, know) with on-demand modes, stack review lenses, and institutional knowledge compounding for Apex, LWC, Flow, integrations, and Agentforce.

interface.shortDescription: Ten Salesforce skills with on-demand modes, stack review lenses, and compounding knowledge.
interface.longDescription: sf-compound-engineering is a skills-first Salesforce compound engineering plugin with ten skills: sf-plan, sf-work, sf-generate, sf-review, sf-debug, sf-deploy, sf-ship, sf-compound, sf-lfg, and sf-know. Each skill has modes whose guides load only when used. Reviews dispatch one subagent per stack lens (Apex, security, Flow, LWC, integration, metadata, tests). Salesforce-specific institutional knowledge is captured in docs/solutions/ and surfaced by sf-learnings-researcher. Skills install natively in Codex; parallel lens dispatch works best in Claude Code or Cursor.
